message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 (`npm test`).

The failing assertion was wrong, not the code. `withVat(250)` is 250 × 1.2 = 300 exactly, with no rounding involved, but the test expected 301. I changed the expectation in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone. Forcing the code to return 301 would have added a one-penny VAT error to every 250p-style amount.

I didn't commit the change.
